caption: A lathe cuts a spinning steel bar, and glowing chips and sparks curl off the tool and drop into the tray.

sa.check: A lathe with a steel bar spinning in it.
A cutting tool is against the bar.
Glowing chips and sparks come off the tool.
They drop into the tray below.
The chips curl as they come off.
The cut comes first and the chips and sparks follow.

pc.expect: The chips and sparks fall downward from the cutting point into the tray, arcing as they go.
pc.fail: Chips or sparks rise from the tool and gather above the lathe; or hang in the air; or drift sideways without dropping; or chips climb up the bar.

pc.expect: Chips and sparks appear only while the tool is cutting, and the glowing chips darken as they cool in the tray; nothing goes back to glowing.
pc.fail: Chips come off while the tool is clear of the bar; or continue after the bar has stopped spinning; or chips in the tray brighten from dark to glowing; or chips flow back onto the bar.

pc.expect: The chips are material removed from the bar: they pile up in the tray and none vanish in mid-air; the bar stays one bar, thinner where cut.
pc.fail: Chips vanish before reaching the tray; or the pile in the tray shrinks while chips keep arriving; or the bar grows thicker as it is cut; or a second bar appears.

pc.expect: The chips leave the tool along the bar's direction of spin, curling away from the cutting edge.
pc.fail: Chips fly against the direction of spin; or spray equally in all directions; or leave from a point on the bar away from the tool.

pc.expect: The tool cuts into the bar's surface; the bar stays held in the chuck and the lathe keeps its shape.
pc.fail: The tool passes through the bar leaving it unmarked; or the bar passes through the chuck; or the tool bends like rubber; or the lathe changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The lathe's colour, the bar's uncut surface and the tray stay the same.
pc.fail: The lathe changes colour; or the bar's uncut part changes finish; or the tray changes shape or place.

note: Glowing chips are the expected look of hot metal; their colour and count are not judged.
